violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. A case of canned food was stored on the floor in the storage room.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Bags of meat pizza toppings in the prep cooler was not date marked.
Food service manager certification. — --Person in charge did not hold an approved food service manager certificate.
